summary: Small rectangular servo programmer PCB with four tactile buttons, two 3-pin male headers and a USB-style connector at one edge. It ships with a separate 4-cell battery tray and a servo extension cable. Only the programmer board is sized here.

mountingSurfaces.description: Underside of the board, which carries a flat gray backing layer that appears to be a spacer or foam pad. It is the likely resting surface.

notes: No dimensions are given in the text and no drawing is visible, so the size is estimated. Assumptions: the board is roughly 48 x 48 mm, about 6 buttons-widths across, with 6 mm tactile switches and 2.54 mm pin-header pitch as scale references. Estimated Z of 14 mm covers the PCB, the backing layer, the tall tactile buttons (about 5 mm) and the header pins standing up above the board. The board shows small mounting holes at the corners, about 2-3 mm in diameter, but their exact positions and diameters cannot be measured, so none are listed. The battery tray (roughly 4-cell AA size) and the 3-wire cable are not included in the bounds. The backing layer thickness is a guess.
confidence_reason: All sizes are visual estimates against standard component sizes.
